oracleRisk.summary: Ethena's official mainnet SDK config enables USDC as the sole suiUSDe mint and redemption collateral and commits a Pyth USDC/USD price into the aggregated-oracle object before either operation. The oracle stores age and price bounds, but the published deployment config identifies no provider other than Pyth and no alternate-feed failover.

branchApplicability.rationale: The official mainnet SDK exposes one enabled collateral path, USDC, for suiUSDe minting and redemption. suiUSDe has no issuer-side borrower liquidation market, while DeepBook borrower liquidations are third-party consumption, so the single USDC/Pyth valuation path is complete at top level.
